decisions.reason: The abstract states that 'Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are among the most common progressive encephalopathies of childhood.' CLN7 is explicitly identified as 'Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 7, one of the late infantile-onset NCLs' in the second sentence. Therefore, CLN7 (as a form of NCL) is clearly established as having progressive encephalopathy as a defining characteristic/phenotype. The quoted sentence, combined with the surrounding context that establishes CLN7 as a type of NCL, directly supports this relationship.
